skill.summary: Cryptographic skill verification. Sign installed skills with SHA-256 content hashes and verify they haven't been tampered with. Detects modified, added, and removed files within skill directories. Free alert layer — upgrade to openclaw-signet-pro for rejection, quarantine, and trust chain restoration.
